## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. Core Read Pattern: Order History View (all 64 files, identical)

```sql
-- The universal pattern: identify buyer-shop pairs with order history
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW order_history as
select
buyer_id as user_id,
shop_id as shop_id,
grass_region,
grass_date
from
mp_order.dws_buyer_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
where tz_type = 'local'
and grass_region = upper('${region}')
and grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
and placed_order_cnt_td > 0;
```

### 2. User-Shop Order History Production (dws_user_shop_order_td)

```sql
-- Join order_history with effective_shop to produce user x shop pairs
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW effective_shop as
select a.shop_id from (
    select shop_id
    from mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
      and tz_type = 'local'
      and status = 1
      and user_status = 1
) a
inner join (
    select shop_id
    from mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
    where tz_type='local' and grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and grass_date = date'${yesterday}' and gmv_td > 0
) b
on a.shop_id = b.shop_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW order_history as
select buyer_id as user_id, shop_id, grass_region, grass_date
from mp_order.dws_buyer_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
where tz_type = 'local'
  and grass_region = upper('${region}')
  and grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
  and placed_order_cnt_td > 0;

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE dws_user_shop_order_td__reg_s0_live
partition (grass_region, grass_date)
select a.user_id, a.shop_id, grass_region, grass_date
from order_history a
inner join effective_shop b
on a.shop_id = b.shop_id;
```

### 3. Potential New Buyer: Exclude Existing Buyers (dws_target_audience_potential_new_buyer)

```sql
-- Collect users who have ordered from each shop, then exclude them
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW order_history as
select shop_id, user_id_hash_id,
collect_list(user_id) as user_id_list from (
    select
    buyer_id as user_id,
    buyer_id % 1000 as user_id_hash_id,
    shop_id as shop_id
    from
    mp_order.dws_buyer_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
    where tz_type = 'local'
    and grass_region = upper('${region}')
    and grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
    and placed_order_cnt_td > 0)
group by shop_id, user_id_hash_id;

-- Exclude existing buyers from all potential buyers
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW all_potential_new_buyer as
select
array_except(a.user_id_list,
    case when b.user_id_list is null then array() else b.user_id_list end
) as user_id_list,
a.shop_id,
a.user_id_hash_id
from all_potential_buyer a
left join order_history b
on a.shop_id = b.shop_id and a.user_id_hash_id = b.user_id_hash_id;
```

### 4. Target Audience Tags: Bitmap of Potential New Buyers (ads_target_audience_tags)

```sql
-- Identify users with order history per shop, then use array_except
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW order_history as
select shop_id,
hash_id,
collect_list(user_id) as user_id_list from (
    select a.user_id, shop_id, hash_id
    from (
        select buyer_id as user_id, shop_id as shop_id
        from mp_order.dws_buyer_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
        where tz_type = 'local'
        and grass_region = upper('${region}')
        and grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
        and placed_order_cnt_td > 0
    ) a
    left join (
        select user_id, hash_id from ordered_user_ids
    ) b
    on a.user_id = b.user_id
)
group by shop_id, hash_id;

-- Generate bitmap for new buyers (exclude existing)
select
'buyer_type' as option,
cast(concat(203001, 1, a.shop_id) as bigint) as tag_id,
a.shop_id as tag_value,
a.hash_id as hash_id,
to_bitmap_udf(array_except(
    a.user_id_list,
    case when b.user_id_list is null then array() else b.user_id_list end
)) as bitmap_info
from shop_level_potential_new_buyer a
left join order_history b
on a.hash_id = b.hash_id and a.shop_id = b.shop_id;
```
